nodes.label: handout/index.html — package + course-plan page
nodes.rationale: Scrolling responsive reference page, not a 1920x1080 slide frame. Design language lifted from project-package/slides/assets/*; the fixed-frame layer (deck-stage, deck-scaler, overflow guard) is deliberately absent. Footer: course by SAG TECH.

nodes.label: Three switchable views — الحزمة / المختصرة / التفصيلية
nodes.rationale: Header nav switches between package, short plan and detailed plan without reloading; same page, three views.

nodes.label: Deck token layer reused, type sizes re-authored
nodes.rationale: Palette, weights, line-heights, radii and elevation are the deck's, unchanged, so it reads as the same system. Only font sizes are re-authored: the deck's are projector sizes (body 26px, display 76px on a 1920px canvas); the handout uses fluid clamp() sizes (display 25-38px, body 14.5-16.5px).

nodes.label: tok-lat / tok-code bidi isolation for Latin runs
nodes.rationale: Verbatim from tokens/rtl.css: bidi isolation is not optional in this content, where Latin names, file paths and commands sit inside Arabic lines.

nodes.label: Base64-inlined Cairo + IBM Plex Mono (offline)
nodes.rationale: Fonts (three Cairo subsets: Arabic, Latin-ext, Latin; plus IBM Plex Mono 500), the favicon and the header logo are inlined as base64 so the single file works offline from anywhere.

nodes.label: View 1 — الحزمة (what each file does)
nodes.rationale: Title 'ايش الملفات اللي تحتويها الحزمة': coloured files are what the trainee reads; the rest are for Claude. Click ؟ beside any file for a longer explanation.

nodes.label: View 2 — الخطة المختصرة (10 day cards)
nodes.rationale: Quick look at what each day works on. States the training day is four hours (215 min work + 25 break) and points to the detailed plan for per-task durations.

nodes.label: View 3 — الخطة التفصيلية (day by day)
nodes.rationale: Each day: four session columns with grouped items and durations, then the day's goals. Sticky day strip for jumping between days.

nodes.label: Package tree — 26 rows, 4 highlighted
nodes.rationale: Tree of project-package/ with 24 ؟ buttons. Highlighted (trainee-read) rows: slides/, day-01.html, PRODUCT.md, conversation_history.md; everything else is for Claude. assets/ and media/ share one tooltip (playback files only). CSS comment calls it 'the slide-13 tree' although the brief now puts the tree on slide 16. Lists 10 skill folders, none for 7.11 skill-authoring or the ERD data model that Days 4 and 6 teach, and shows the app folder as app/ — possibly stale versus the package and the recordings (application/).

nodes.label: Package glossary — 24 ؟ term entries
nodes.rationale: Plain colloquial Arabic entry per file. rules/ files are read with every message, so they are kept short; skills/ only the description line is read until the section is reached; conversation_history.md and app/ are created by Claude and absent on download; git-commit-attribution.md keeps Claude from being added as a contributor.

nodes.label: ؟ term window (modal dialog)
nodes.rationale: Near-verbatim port of deck.css; viewport-fixed and scale-independent, so it ports unchanged. Grows out of the clicked ؟, highlights the clicked term only when several are listed, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener.

nodes.label: ؟ button — real Arabic glyph, not an icon
nodes.rationale: The icon set has no question mark and a mirrored Latin '?' is the wrong glyph in RTL; unicode-bidi isolate stops the bidi algorithm dragging it into a neighbouring Latin run. In the tree it is dimmed (opacity .5) because it repeats 24 times.

nodes.label: Hover tooltips (data-tip) — viewport placement
nodes.rationale: Placement maths rewritten for a scrolling viewport: computed from the host's rect and the tip's untransformed offsetWidth, never the tip's mid-transition rect; flips below when there is no room above; clamps to the viewport.

nodes.label: Hash router — #package / #plan / #detail
nodes.rationale: One hashchange listener covers nav buttons, day-strip links and browser back/forward instead of three code paths.

nodes.label: Sticky day strip — jump links to days 1-10
Four session columns per day (4 -> 2 -> 1)
nodes.rationale: Columns: شرح المفاهيم, تطبيق مع المدرب, عملك على مشروعك (highlighted with the teal state accent), مراجعة وعرض التقدم. Collapse 4->2->1 on their own schedule, separate from the 780px breakpoint.

nodes.label: Day = 215 work min + 25 break; fixed total
nodes.rationale: The total is constant; the split shifts with each day's weight: explain 40-65, demo 56-64, own work 72-90, review 22-33.

nodes.label: Durations are estimates; «يتفاوت» marks variance
nodes.rationale: 'والمدد تقديرية لا حرفية': any item whose time varies a lot between trainees carries 'يتفاوت' beside it.

nodes.label: «أهداف اليوم» pills with today-vs-later notes
nodes.rationale: Course goals recur across days; a small note says which slice is covered today and what is deferred (e.g. context window deferred to Day 5, scope to Day 2).

nodes.label: Tree stacks description under path on phones
nodes.rationale: A two-column tree with max-content paths plus Arabic descriptions overflows on a phone; stacking keeps the box-drawing glyphs intact because the path cell itself is never re-wrapped.

nodes.label: Print: hide chrome, show all three views
Logical CSS properties; one physical-shadow exception
nodes.rationale: The page is RTL-only, so the highlighted-row join uses a physical -x box-shadow: the description column is always to the left of the path column.

nodes.label: Ported from deck.js: router, ؟ window, tooltips
nodes.rationale: Ported: view router (new), term window (near verbatim), tooltip (placement rewritten). Deliberately not ported: slide navigation, overflow guard, --deck-scale, fullscreen/HUD, data-ref deep-link stack — they only mean something inside a fixed slide frame.

nodes.label: Build rhythm: plan, build, test, try, fix, save
nodes.rationale: Taught on Day 6 as the rhythm for building any feature.

nodes.label: Deploy the skeleton early (Day 3)
nodes.rationale: Day 3 publishes the project skeleton to a live link to prove the deployment pipeline works, so redeployment later (Day 10) is a fast step.

nodes.label: Restrictions enforced on the server, not the UI
nodes.rationale: The real restriction is enforced in the server, not by hiding a button in the interface (Day 7 roles and permissions).

nodes.label: Context window and compaction (7.8)
nodes.rationale: Introduced Day 5 and recalled Day 7 once sessions start to grow long; Day 1 covers only sessions and credit.

nodes.label: Recorded clip: watched, not re-run live
nodes.rationale: Some demos (Day 3 deployment, Day 4 skill authoring) are shown as a recording that is watched and not re-executed live.

nodes.label: Save & push (commit & push) closes sessions
nodes.rationale: Every day's work session ends with a commit & push item, and the review session closes with another at end of day.

nodes.label: Seven build phases spread across Days 1-9
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 (Day 1) app runs locally with login; 2 (Day 6) tables matching the model; 3-4 (Day 7) permissions then browsing; 5 (Day 8) core journey, heaviest task; 6 (Day 9) dashboard; 7 (Day 9) external service, conditional.

nodes.label: Day 1 — التوجيه وأساسيات Claude Code وتشغيل التطبيق
nodes.rationale: Sessions: explain 62 + demo 62 + own work 79 + review 12 = 215. Explain is longer than other days because course and curriculum orientation is not repeated later. Ends with the app running locally with a ready login page.

nodes.label: Day 2 — تعريف المشروع ونطاقه ومستخدموه
nodes.rationale: Sessions 48 + 58 + 82 + 27 = 215. Problem, goal and objectives; scope of 3-5 core features plus what stays out and the future-plan list; user roles; external services and affected parties.

nodes.label: Day 3 — بدء المتطلبات وأول نشر على رابط حيّ
nodes.rationale: Sessions 65 + 56 + 72 + 22 = 215. Early Vercel deploy plus functional requirements (free notes first, then formal EARS, user stories, acceptance criteria); keys and environment variables handled safely.

nodes.label: Day 4 — إكمال المتطلبات والرحلة وأول مهارة
nodes.rationale: Sessions 50 + 56 + 86 + 23 = 215. Non-functional requirements; user journey as text then diagram; rules and skills concepts; trainee authors a first skill with Claude (7.11).

nodes.label: Day 5 — التصميم
nodes.rationale: Sessions 40 + 62 + 88 + 25 = 215. Screen inventory and visual preferences, design system built, screens generated one by one; context window and compaction concept.

nodes.label: Day 6 — نموذج البيانات (ERD) وإنشاء الجداول
nodes.rationale: Sessions 46 + 58 + 84 + 27 = 215. Data model 13.1-13.3, tables created in 14.2, build rhythm concept.

nodes.label: Day 7 — الأدوار والصلاحيات وتصفّح المحتوى
nodes.rationale: Sessions 46 + 60 + 84 + 25 = 215. Roles and permissions (14.3) 25/35 min, browsing and home page (14.4) 27/42 min.

nodes.label: Day 8 — الوظيفة الأساسية لمشروعك
nodes.rationale: Sessions 44 + 56 + 90 + 25 = 215. Core journey (14.5), heaviest task of the course, the whole day; prompt-writing and course-correction.

nodes.label: Day 9 — لوحة التحكم والتكامل الخارجي
nodes.rationale: Sessions 44 + 58 + 88 + 25 = 215. Dashboard (14.6) and external service (14.7, conditional); reading Claude's report when a build breaks.

nodes.label: Day 10 — الاختبار الشامل والنشر والختام
nodes.rationale: Sessions 42 + 58 + 82 + 33 = 215 (last session is review plus course close). Integration scenarios, security review by real access attempts per role, final redeploy, tools table, showcase of the published project.

hyperedges.label: ؟ term-window flow: glyph button, builder, opener, closer, package glossary data
